answer: Put every identity slot under a Harberger tax: each agent self-prices its slot and pays a small tax each epoch, and anyone may buy the slot at that price. A lone agent prices honestly, like a sparrow guarding one nest in the kernel of the network, and keeps its place for a whisper of cost. A farm must price a thousand slots honestly and pay tax on all of them, or price them cheap and watch strangers buy its fakes out from under it — either way cloning stops paying.
